positive_snippets:
Also known as Hotel S Gambhir now turned their whole business in OYO.
Quite an okayish place to stay if you have to spend a night or two.
Not recommended for longer stays and Family.
Good spot for couples to spend time together.
Rooms are Spacious with AC, but not clean properly.
You can feel dust on the floor if you walk barefoot.
TV's are installed but not working.
AC is working but there is no remote to adjust the temperature.
Toilets are not clean properly, water is highly chlorinated not recommended for hairwash.
No restaurant facility provided you have to order your own food from zomato or swiggy, else pickup from nearby restaurant.
Overall not such a good experience but if you are in a need and want to spend a night or two with good locality give it a Go.
negative_snippets:
Worst experience ever..
Only one word for this property - Terrible. The rooms were so small, the linen was not clean and there were ants and mosquitoes in the room. The faucet wasn't working. Even after requesting them to change the room, nothing made any difference. They are charging 2x the price for everything - stay, food, everything. It's not even the standard of a normal hotel, forget about the Townhouse.
If you want to ruin your experience, please ignore this review. Otherwise, look for other options. It's not even worth a single penny. You'll find plenty of options in much less price and has a much better experience.

Nobody can have worst experience than this. First room that was given was very dirty. There was white spots on bedsheets, bed cover, yellow on pillows. The second room they gave in exchange was no better. Same condition. Toilets looked like they were never cleaned once. Staff was very rude and was not helpful.

It's a nightmare experience. No cleaning. Special stains are there everywhere. Water bottle provided were of broken seals. Not a good staff. No extra matress even if you have paid online. You can get some special treatment via the smell that you will get in the bathrooms. Zero maintenance. Does not even worth 100 rs for 1 night. Thanks @oyo for this experience.
